name: Warm Lentil Beet Salad
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) brown or green lentils
Dressing: 2 tsp olive oil, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tsp mustard, black pepper
steps: Roast the beetroot with the oil at 200°C for 30 minutes until tender.
Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until tender but not mushy; drain.
Whisk the dressing and toss it with the warm lentils.
Layer the greens with the lentils, beetroot and tofu. Finish with parsley and salt.
note: Lentils hold their shape and give about 17 g protein with high fibre per serving.
